items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: we did, you know, Jerome Kern.

ctx.x: Well what was your — name a few tunes that were in The Millionaires’ repertoire.
Well we did all standards, Cole Porter, Rodgers & Hart, we did, you know, Jerome Kern. We did all those kind of tunes. And then you know the jazz tunes.
Were people dancing to your music?
